note: The graded episode's service (graded_service.py). data_dir: the service account's data folder, installed by setup.sh from online/data (mode 0700): the hidden episode (episode.json: the drawn site of the hidden set, its package's sha256, the grader's seed rule, the reference's energy on the site), the oracle token's digest and cell/ (the offline grader's own cell in the layout of tests/: a byte copy of tests/cabincell, tests/grader_config.json, tests/reference and the station map of tests/setup_payload). cell_limits: the program's two wall-clock budgets of the cell (cell.budget.silence_s, cell.budget.program_compute_s) switched off: the graded episode has no program time and no silence rule (simulated time passes only inside the agent's own calls); every other per-site budget is the offline grader's (2400 s of simulated time, 400 colour and 300 depth frames, 20 captures, the fan-stop and light quotas, the first valid report, a step of at most 5 s). prep_s = the task's agent budget on main (the start must come within it of the service's first start); graded_s = the graded window from the start, the contract's default of 3 h (the cell's own work for a whole site at its bounds, 2400 s simulated at about 1.1 s of wall clock per simulated second plus the frames, is under 1 h; the reference program's episode takes 12-31 min). request_cap_s bounds one call (the longest blocking calls, dock and capture, stop within 600 s of simulated time); privileged_request_cap_s the oracle's one reference_run call; end_cap_s the end (the 60 s settle, the cell's record, the grade). practice_closed_flag: created at the start, before the start is persisted; the rehearsal facility (practiced.py, REHEARSAL_CLOSED_FLAG) then ends an open run and refuses new ones. Dual mode: at the start (before it is charged), or when the preparation window closes without a start, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into snapshot_dir (no symlink followed; main's 60 MB submission cap, the engine's entry and depth limits: over them the status is too_large and nothing is copied); the offline grader grades that snapshot. A copy at the window's close that still fails after snapshot_attempts tries (snapshot_retry_delay_s apart) is recorded as failed, and the program item then scores 0. env: the cell's numerics as the grader pins them (tests/test.sh, runtime key cell.recipe.env), its asset root, OSMesa with 4 rasteriser threads.
